title: `format_secs` prints 5,976.100s for 5,976.997 s
body:
`Stats::format_secs` in `nail/src/stats.rs` prints a `Duration` as whole seconds with thousands separators, a dot, and two digits of fraction:

```rust
let whole = Self::format_num(secs.trunc() as u64);
let frac = (secs.fract() * 100.0).round() as u64;
format!("{whole}.{frac:02}s")
```

A fraction of 0.995 or more rounds to 100, and the whole part is never carried. A chunk-size run of the mgy search printed the alignment branch as `cpu 5,976.100s`, where the value was about 5,977.00 s. The `-s` runtime tree is the only place this shows, so results are not affected.
